summary: Audited 2000 MCQs in waves 1-4 (Units 1-2) against the locked 0264 whitelist and blacklist. 1916 passed and 84 were rejected. Rejects are dominated by blacklisted conglomerate integration distractors, plus paternalistic leadership, Mayo/Hawthorne human-relations theory, McGregor Theory X/Y and zero-hours contracts. PEST, CPA and aptitude-test keyword hits were verified as false positives (pest control,  Certified Public Accountant qualification, and a whitelisted selection-testing method) and were not rejected. Fayol attributions were retained because the tested management functions are explicitly whitelisted in 2.2.
